title: Error

code.description: A machine-readable error code that was returned.

anyOf.description: The original error type, or null if it was not recorded.
The request parameter associated with the error, or null if none was recorded.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error that was returned.

headers.description: Headers returned with the original error. These can include Retry-After, Retry-After-Ms, and, on opted-in deployments, x-openai-inference-capacity-reason.

description: An error that occurred while generating the response.
